name: net.tls
doc:
The Zell-source net.tls (see sema/stdsrc.rs for the rules): TLS 1.3
(RFC 8446) and TLS 1.2 restricted to ECDHE + AEAD (RFC 5246, 5288, 7905,
7627), client and server, over net TCP connections. This file holds
the public API, the key schedule and the record layer; the handshake
state machines are in tls_client.zl and tls_server.zl. Cryptography is
done by the C primitives of crypto.* (runtime/src/crypto/); the
record AEAD contexts live in []byte blobs (rtAeadNew).

Wire constants are written as numbers with their RFC names in comments:
record types 20 change_cipher_spec, 21 alert, 22 handshake,
23 application_data; handshake types 1 client_hello, 2 server_hello,
4 new_session_ticket, 8 encrypted_extensions, 11 certificate,
12 server_key_exchange, 13 certificate_request, 14 server_hello_done,
15 certificate_verify, 16 client_key_exchange, 20 finished,
24 key_update, 254 message_hash.

items.doc: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).
items.summary: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).

items.name: RequestClientCert
items.doc: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).
items.summary: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).

items.name: RequireAndVerifyClientCert
items.doc: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).
items.summary: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).

items.name: RequireAnyClientCert
items.doc: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).
items.summary: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).

items.name: V12
items.doc: TLS 1.2 protocol version.
items.summary: TLS 1.2 protocol version.

items.name: V13
items.doc: TLS 1.3 protocol version.
items.summary: TLS 1.3 protocol version.

items.name: VerifyClientCertIfGiven
items.doc: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).
items.summary: Client-certificate policy of a TLS server (Config.ClientAuth).

items.name: CipherSuiteName
items.doc: CipherSuiteName is the IANA name of a supported suite ("" if unknown).
items.summary: CipherSuiteName is the IANA name of a supported suite ("" if unknown).

items.name: Client
items.signature: async func Client(raw net.Conn, cfg Config) Conn!
items.doc:
Client wraps an established TCP connection as the client side of TLS
and runs the handshake.
items.summary: Client wraps an established TCP connection as the client side of TLS and runs the handshake.

items.name: DeriveSecret
items.signature: func DeriveSecret(hash string, secret []byte, label string, transcriptHash []byte) []byte!
items.doc:
DeriveSecret is Derive-Secret(secret, label, messages) of RFC 8446 7.1
taking the transcript hash of the messages.
items.summary: DeriveSecret is Derive-Secret(secret, label, messages) of RFC 8446 7.1 taking the transcript hash of the messages.

items.name: Dial
items.signature: async func Dial(addr string, cfg Config) Conn!
items.doc: Dial connects to addr ("host:port") and runs a TLS client handshake.
items.summary: Dial connects to addr ("host:port") and runs a TLS client handshake.

items.name: DialTimeout
items.signature: async func DialTimeout(addr string, cfg Config, ms int) Conn!
items.doc:
DialTimeout is Dial with a timeout (ms, 0 = none) for the connect and
for every network operation of the handshake.
items.summary: DialTimeout is Dial with a timeout (ms, 0 = none) for the connect and for every network operation of the handshake.

items.name: ExpandLabel
items.signature: func ExpandLabel(hash string, secret []byte, label string, context []byte, length int) []byte!
items.doc:
ExpandLabel is HKDF-Expand-Label of TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446 7.1): the hash is
"sha256" or "sha384", label without the "tls13 " prefix.
items.summary: ExpandLabel is HKDF-Expand-Label of TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446 7.1): the hash is "sha256" or "sha384", label without the "tls13 " prefix.

items.name: Listen
items.signature: func Listen(addr string, cfg ServerConfig) Listener!
items.doc: Listen listens on addr ("host:port") and returns a TLS listener.
items.summary: Listen listens on addr ("host:port") and returns a TLS listener.

items.name: LoadKeyPair
items.signature: func LoadKeyPair(certPEM string, keyPEM string) Certificate!
items.doc:
LoadKeyPair parses a PEM certificate chain and a PEM private key and
checks that the key belongs to the leaf.
items.summary: LoadKeyPair parses a PEM certificate chain and a PEM private key and checks that the key belongs to the leaf.

items.name: LoadKeyPairFiles
items.signature: func LoadKeyPairFiles(certFile string, keyFile string) Certificate!
items.doc: LoadKeyPairFiles is LoadKeyPair reading two files.
items.summary: LoadKeyPairFiles is LoadKeyPair reading two files.

items.name: NewSessionCache
items.doc: NewSessionCache returns an empty client session cache (for resumption).
items.summary: NewSessionCache returns an empty client session cache (for resumption).

items.name: OpenRecord
items.signature: func OpenRecord(suite int, key []byte, iv []byte, seq int, rec []byte) []byte!
items.doc:
OpenRecord removes the protection of a TLS 1.3 record made by SealRecord
and returns the inner content type followed by the content.
items.summary: OpenRecord removes the protection of a TLS 1.3 record made by SealRecord and returns the inner content type followed by the content.

items.name: SealRecord
items.signature: func SealRecord(suite int, key []byte, iv []byte, seq int, contentType int, data []byte) []byte!
items.doc:
SealRecord protects one TLS 1.3 record (RFC 8446 5.2) with the traffic
key and IV of a suite (0x1301..0x1303) at sequence number seq, and
returns the whole record. Low-level: for tests and tools.
items.summary: SealRecord protects one TLS 1.3 record (RFC 8446 5.2) with the traffic key and IV of a suite (0x1301..0x1303) at sequence number seq, and returns the whole record.

items.name: Server
items.signature: func Server(l net.Listener, cfg ServerConfig) Listener!
items.doc: Server makes a TLS listener from a TCP listener.
items.summary: Server makes a TLS listener from a TCP listener.

items.name: ServerConn
items.signature: func ServerConn(raw net.Conn, cfg ServerConfig) Conn!
items.doc:
ServerConn wraps an accepted TCP connection as the server side of TLS;
the handshake runs on first use (or Handshake()).
items.summary: ServerConn wraps an accepted TCP connection as the server side of TLS; the handshake runs on first use (or Handshake()).

items.name: Certificate
items.doc: Certificate is a certificate chain (leaf first) with its private key.
items.summary: Certificate is a certificate chain (leaf first) with its private key.

items.name: Config
items.doc: Config configures a client.
items.summary: Config configures a client.

members.name: ServerName
members.doc:
Host name for SNI and certificate verification (default: the host
part of the Dial address).
members.summary: Host name for SNI and certificate verification (default: the host part of the Dial address).

members.name: ALPN
members.doc: Application protocols to offer, in preference order ("h2", "http/1.1").
members.summary: Application protocols to offer, in preference order ("h2", "http/1.1").

members.name: RootCAs
members.doc: Trust anchors; nil means the system roots (crypto.x509.SystemRoots).
members.summary: Trust anchors; nil means the system roots (crypto.x509.SystemRoots).

members.name: ClientCert
members.doc: Certificate presented when the server asks for one.
members.summary: Certificate presented when the server asks for one.

members.name: InsecureSkipVerify
members.doc:
Skips the chain and host name checks (the handshake signature is
still checked). Only for tests and self-signed development servers.
members.summary: Skips the chain and host name checks (the handshake signature is still checked).

members.name: MinVersion
members.doc: Oldest and newest versions (V12, V13); 0 means V12 and V13.
members.summary: Oldest and newest versions (V12, V13); 0 means V12 and V13.

members.name: Sessions
members.doc: Cache of session tickets for resumption (nil: no resumption).
members.summary: Cache of session tickets for resumption (nil: no resumption).

items.name: Conn
items.doc:
Conn is a TLS connection. Copies share the connection. The handshake
runs on the first Read or Write (or Handshake()).
items.summary: Conn is a TLS connection.

members.name: Handshake
members.doc: Runs the handshake if it has not run yet.
members.summary: Runs the handshake if it has not run yet.

members.name: Read
members.doc:
Reads up to n bytes of application data; an empty result means the
peer closed the connection (close_notify or end of stream).
members.summary: Reads up to n bytes of application data; an empty result means the peer closed the connection (close_notify or end of stream).

members.name: ReadString
members.doc: ReadString is Read as a string.
members.summary: ReadString is Read as a string.

members.name: Write
members.doc: Writes all of data; yields the number of bytes written.
members.summary: Writes all of data; yields the number of bytes written.

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString writes text.
members.summary: WriteString writes text.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Sends close_notify (best effort) and closes the socket.
members.summary: Sends close_notify (best effort) and closes the socket.

members.name: IsClosed
members.doc: IsClosed reports whether the connection is closed.
members.summary: IsClosed reports whether the connection is closed.

members.name: SetTimeout
members.doc: Timeout in ms for each later network read/write (0: none).
members.summary: Timeout in ms for each later network read/write (0: none).

members.name: LocalAddr
members.doc: LocalAddr returns the local "ip:port".
members.summary: LocalAddr returns the local "ip:port".

members.name: RemoteAddr
members.doc: RemoteAddr returns the peer's "ip:port".
members.summary: RemoteAddr returns the peer's "ip:port".

members.name: ConnectionState
members.doc: ConnectionState returns the negotiated parameters of the handshake.
members.summary: ConnectionState returns the negotiated parameters of the handshake.

members.name: KeyUpdate
members.doc:
Updates the sending keys and asks the peer to update its own
(TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate, RFC 8446 4.6.3).
members.summary: Updates the sending keys and asks the peer to update its own (TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate, RFC 8446 4.6.3).

items.name: ConnectionState
items.doc: ConnectionState describes an established connection.
items.summary: ConnectionState describes an established connection.

members.name: Version
members.doc: V12 or V13.
members.summary: V12 or V13.

members.name: ALPN
members.doc: Negotiated application protocol ("" if none).
members.summary: Negotiated application protocol ("" if none).

members.name: PeerCertificates
members.doc: Leaf first, as sent by the peer.
members.summary: Leaf first, as sent by the peer.

members.name: VerifiedChain
members.doc: The verified chain (empty when not verified).
members.summary: The verified chain (empty when not verified).

members.name: Resumed
members.doc: The handshake resumed an earlier session.
members.summary: The handshake resumed an earlier session.

members.name: VersionName
members.doc: VersionName returns the negotiated version as "TLS 1.3" or "TLS 1.2".
members.summary: VersionName returns the negotiated version as "TLS 1.3" or "TLS 1.2".

items.name: Listener
items.doc: Listener accepts TLS connections from a TCP listener.
items.summary: Listener accepts TLS connections from a TCP listener.

members.name: Accept
members.doc: Waits for the next TCP connection; its handshake runs on first use.
members.summary: Waits for the next TCP connection; its handshake runs on first use.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Close stops listening.
members.summary: Close stops listening.

members.name: Addr
members.doc: Addr returns the bound "ip:port".
members.summary: Addr returns the bound "ip:port".

members.name: Port
members.doc: Port returns the bound port.
members.summary: Port returns the bound port.

items.name: ServerConfig
items.doc: ServerConfig configures a server.
items.summary: ServerConfig configures a server.

members.name: Certificates
members.doc:
Certificates to serve; the first whose names match the SNI host is
used, else the first.
members.summary: Certificates to serve; the first whose names match the SNI host is used, else the first.

members.name: ClientAuth
members.doc:
NoClientCert (default), RequestClientCert, RequireAnyClientCert,
VerifyClientCertIfGiven or RequireAndVerifyClientCert.
members.summary: NoClientCert (default), RequestClientCert, RequireAnyClientCert, VerifyClientCertIfGiven or RequireAndVerifyClientCert.

members.name: ClientCAs
members.doc: Roots for verifying client certificates (nil: system roots).
members.summary: Roots for verifying client certificates (nil: system roots).

members.name: ALPN
members.doc: Application protocols the server supports, in preference order.
members.summary: Application protocols the server supports, in preference order.

members.name: DisableSessionTickets
members.doc: Turns off session tickets (TLS 1.3 PSK and RFC 5077 tickets).
members.summary: Turns off session tickets (TLS 1.3 PSK and RFC 5077 tickets).

members.name: TicketKey
members.doc: 32-byte key protecting tickets (random per Server when empty).
members.summary: 32-byte key protecting tickets (random per Server when empty).

items.name: SessionCache
items.doc:
SessionCache keeps the latest session ticket per server for clients
(Config.Sessions). Safe to share between connections.
items.summary: SessionCache keeps the latest session ticket per server for clients (Config.Sessions).

members.name: Len
members.doc: Number of cached sessions.
members.summary: Number of cached sessions.
